Introduction

Hong Da-bin is a South Korean rapper and singer originally known by his stage name DPR LIVE. A founding member of the creative collective Dream Perfect Regime (DPR), he spent his childhood overseas before returning to Korea, where he discovered his passion for music during his military service. In 2015, Dabin debuted with the track “Till I Die” and gained widespread recognition with his 2017 EP Coming to You Live. Over the years, DPR Live became known for his introspective lyrics, smooth genre-blending hip-hop and R&B style, and cinematic music videos produced by the DPR collective.

In late 2023, he announced a shift to performing under his birth name, launching his own label CTYL (Coming To You Live) to pursue a more authentic creative process. As Dabin, he released his debut album Giggles in 2024. Continuing this new chapter, he dropped his fourth EP, senseS, in 2025, further showcasing his evolving artistry while maintaining his ties to DPR. Though he has temporarily stepped back from the DPR LIVE persona, Dabin has expressed intentions to revisit it in the future, reflecting an ongoing creative evolution.

As of 2025, Hong Da-bin/Dabin represents a matured artist balancing personal authenticity with the innovative spirit of the DPR collective, continually pushing boundaries in Korean hip-hop and R&B.
